content.text: the cargo guard blocked a multi-line command again

input.prompt: Fix the cargo guard so backslash-newline continuations are joined before segmenting.

content.text: Committed @@HEAD@@ fix(cupcake): join backslash-newline continuations before segmenting. opa test: PASS.

The cause was the cargo guard reading a backslash at the end of a line as its own command, so the continuation became a separate segment. The subagent's commit @@HEAD@@ joins those lines before segmenting, and its policy tests pass.
